key_idea: Maintain the Champernowne word modulo k incrementally: w_i = w_{i-1} * 10^{digits(i)} + i (mod k).
sketch: Iterate i from 1 to n, keeping cur = (cur * (10^len(i) mod k) + i) mod k and counting how often cur is 0. Track the power of ten by multiplying by 10 whenever i reaches the next power. O(n). Overflow: cur<k<=1e9 and 10^len<=1e6, so the product fits in 64-bit but not in 32-bit. k=1 counts every word.
